title: Shimura curves of discriminant 14 and 15 and associated Heun Functions
summary: We study the Shimura curves $X_D^*(1)$ of discriminant $D$ for $D=14, 15$ relating specific weight $4$ modular forms on these Shimura curves to the associated Heun functions for the quadrilateral group. We also discuss how the Picard-Fuchs equation of the associated family of abelian surfaces has solutions coming from modular forms on $X^*_{D}(1)$. We determine the rational exceptional sets of the associated Heun functions, and the algebraic values attained by the Heun function at these points.
